name: GOOSE interlock subscriber interface
summary: Receives the assigned equipment-state message used by a local interlock decision.
description: Receives the assigned equipment-state message used by a local interlock decision. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Subscribed equipment states” at the input and “Local interlock information” at the output. Missing-data response must be defined.
